# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old, later growing up into a young lady  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and companion to Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face, a snubbed nose, and a wide mouth that gives very wide smiles. In her earlier years, her hair was braided in innumerable plaits adorned with bright blue bows that seemed to be everywhere. Upon growing into young ladyhood, she discarded the blue bows in favor of styling her hair in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted, cheerful, and intensely loyal handmaiden who is utterly devoted to her mistress. She displays brisk efficiency and enthusiasm when working around the house. Though she may be amused or weary at times, she never lets Miss Lavendar see any criticism of her imaginative play.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011)_

## History

Leonora Bowman was taken in by Miss Lavendar Lewis at the age of fourteen to live at Echo Lodge for board and clothes. Because her three older sisters—Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina—had previously served as Miss Lavendar's handmaidens, Miss Lavendar dubbed her 'Charlotta the Fourth'. She proved to be the best and most understanding of the Bowman girls, keeping her mistress's secrets and welcoming guests like Anne Shirley and Diana Barry with open arms. She helped energetically with the garden, sewing, and house preparations leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding to Stephen Irving. After the marriage, she moved with the Irvings to Boston, where she suffered from severe homesickness. She returned with the family to Echo Lodge during subsequent summers, having grown into a fashionable young lady who maintained a fond friendship with Anne.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Her birth name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Youngest of the Bowman sisters who worked for Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Dubbed 'Charlotta the Fourth' by Miss Lavendar to avoid confusion with her older sisters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
